topic: Relative and absolute dating of rocks
key_concepts: Relative dating determines whether rocks are older or younger than other rocks
Absolute dating assigns numerical ages in years to rocks
Principle of superposition states oldest undisturbed rock layers are at the bottom
Principle of original horizontality states sediments accumulate in horizontal beds
Principle of cross-cutting relationships states intrusions and faults are younger than roc
Principle of inclusions states rock fragments are older than the rock layer containing the
Unconformities are gaps in the rock record caused by erosion or non-deposition
Disconformity, nonconformity, and angular unconformity are three types of unconformities
Radiometric dating uses radioactive elements with known decay rates to determine rock age
Half-life is the time needed for half of a radioactive element to decay
Radiocarbon dating uses the ratio of carbon-14 to carbon-12 in organic remains
Fission track dating counts tracks from uranium-238 splitting to estimate mineral age
